description:
The newest version of Apüna that merges modern looks of fully integrated cockpits, with a very broad tire range that allows this platform to blur the lines between road and gravel. The ENVE AR In-Route Fork provides an increased tire clearance of up to 700Cx40. It comes fitted with UDH dropouts and a T47 bottom bracket shell.

Handcrafted with precision in El Retiro, Colombia, we meticulously build each in-house Apüna frameset using the finest materials and techniques. This one-by-one approach ensures that every bike is custom-tuned to match your riding style and requirements, delivering unparalleled ride quality, durability, and performance.

The Apüna benefits from the added stiffness of ovalized Columbus steel tubing, providing a solid, responsive platform without sacrificing the comfort that steel is known for. With the ample tire clearance range, the Apüna is ready for whatever road, trail, or unknown path lies ahead.

"Named after the Wayuu word for "path," the Apüna is inspired by the vast, open landscapes of La Guajira - where endless trails connect remote lands, and speed is essential to conquer the terrain. Designed for those who crave the precision of the road yet seek the freedom to explore beyond it, the Apüna delivers the perfect balance of speed, control, and versatility."
